# Live Validation Contract Fixtures

Fixtures in this directory cover Roadmap 40 API and event contracts:

- live validation attempts and denials,
- side-effect ledger entries and lists,
- replay support matrix rows,
- kill-switch state,
- reconciliation resolution,
- retention policy summaries,
- original-versus-live comparison evidence,
- lifecycle and side-effect events.

Fixture payloads must avoid secrets and real external account identifiers.
